email.subject: RE: Cancel order 2026/OS/118
email.body:
Dear Mr Zieliński,

the goods already left our warehouse on 14 July with Wisła-Trans (consignment WTS-PL-260714) and will arrive tomorrow. We can take them back unopened with a 10 % restocking fee, or you keep them. Please let me know how you want to proceed.

Best regards
Alex Morgan
